message:
feat(ql-econ): cost_to_completion visual class, shared claims, units path, scope coverage, route verdict

P5: extend the canonical owner. visual class (4 calls x 150k, deopt), shared_with costs 0 and is counted,
clean counts (o_total/o_zero/o_shared/o_irreducible/o_semantic_consumers), units cost path with reserve and
unmeasured allowance, two-way gate/claim coverage (UNCOVERED_GATE, ORPHAN_CLAIM), and --route whose verdict
is route_admission.admit's verdict.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

feat(ql-econ): wu_packet compile/verify, packets derived from the claims IR

P3: fingerprint = unit + claims + gates + product HEAD + IR sha256; verify prints CURRENT or STALE.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

feat(ql-econ): boundary_receipts, runtime-generated per-call receipts and shadow stall governor

P4: events and advancements derived from the transcript; the model logs nothing.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

feat(ql-econ): manifest_commit driver and the commit manifest for this build

Zero-model driver: tests first, pathspec-scoped commit per entry, JSON log per step.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
